title: feat: add community /embeddings endpoint support
author: YoannDev90
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds community embedding registration to the dashboard, Account API, and polli CLI.
- Proxies POST /v1/embeddings to OpenAI-compatible community upstreams and lists them in the embedding and OpenAI model catalogs.
- Uses token-only promptTextPrice billing from positive upstream usage.prompt_tokens.
- Reuses community authentication, rate limits, fallbacks, owner rewards, and the shared endpoint timeout.

## Checks

- polli CLI focused tests
- polli CLI build
- Biome
- GitHub formatting and CodeQL checks

Fixes #13261

gist.headline: The community remembers vectors
gist.blurb: Community models can now lend the hive their embeddings, not just their words. Register an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and its vector garden joins the catalog.
gist.summary: Added community registration and routing for OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/embeddings endpoints across the dashboard, Account API, and polli CLI, with catalog discovery, token-based billing, fallbacks, rate limits, and owner rewards.
gist.impact: Community model owners can expose embedding models through the same Pollinations catalogs and shared endpoint protections, while developers can use them through the standard OpenAI-compatible embeddings API.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a community embedding endpoint as a cozy shared garden where words are transformed into glowing vector seeds and arranged into neat constellation-like patterns. Polli should be actively planting or sorting these vector seeds beside a friendly CRT Monitor Robot displaying a simple terminal command such as POST /v1/embeddings; code-plants and labeled community garden plots represent registered upstream models.
